result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.trav_out()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Traverse from selected nodes to outward neighbors. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L8349-L8394){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.trav_out() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Outward traversal](/assets/graphs/trav-out.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Left: in a seven-node directed graph, node C is selected (accent). Right: after trav_out() the selection has moved one step along C's outgoing edges, to B and D; C is no longer selected, and A and E, whose edges point into C, are not reached." width="100%"} From the currently selected nodes, moves to all nodes that can be reached by following outward edges (where selected nodes are sources). The current node selection is replaced with the traversed nodes. For directed graphs, follows edges in the forward direction. For undirected graphs, follows edges in all directions (equivalent to `trav_both()`). ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Starting from "A" and moving along outgoing edges reaches "B", replacing the node selection with whatever the traversal finds: ::: {#21fd6c59 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph(directed=True) graph.add_node("A").add_node("B").add_node("C") graph.add_edge("A", "B") graph.add_edge("B", "C") node_a_id = graph.get_id_from_label("A") graph.select_nodes_by_id([node_a_id]).trav_out() graph.get_selected_node_ids() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` [2] ``` ::: :::
